breakdown.description: A small-angle approximation is used for a large wedge/turning angle where the approximation is not valid.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly uses the small-angle approximation (beta ≈ mu + theta) for a 25-degree wedge angle, directly repeating the error from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth requires using the full theta-beta-Mach relation and explicitly prohibits small-angle approximations for this large turning angle. The agent failed to identify or correct this inconsistency.
